## Setting
Setting the cleaning arrangement for the shared areas. Five housemates share a kitchen, a bathroom, and a living room, and the informal habit they started with has stopped working. They are settling on one arrangement for the coming year. Participants: Shizue, Minako, Sakura, Benjamin and Servas. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- Bathroom spray stock and the tin's receipts
- Management office rate sheet and billing
- Stopwatch timing of a full pass
- Standard terms of the outside firm
- Bathroom grout after the July scrub
- What each housemate counts as done
- Absences on the wall calendar
- A fortnight's watch on kitchen use
- Rows recorded in the house chat
- Note left by the previous tenants

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Minako, Benjamin, Sakura, Shizue and Servas. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. | Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |
| 2 | each participant is told what they found out (that participant only) | 4 turns | nothing |

Name: Shizue
Age: 78
Gender: female
Personality: Shizue has a very calm and gentle personality. Even as she has grown older, she continues to smile warmly at those around her and is a very caring person. She is always considerate of others, friendly, and sometimes shows a playful side. She often reaches out to those who are feeling down with kind words and never hesitates to lend a helping hand when needed, which has earned her the affection of many people in the village and community. Through her years of life experience, Shizue has come to understand the importance of living peacefully with others.
Concern: The bleach, the bin bags and the sponges keep coming out of whoever's wallet is nearest, and nobody has settled up since spring. Whatever we agree to, I want to know what it costs us month to month and who ends up out of pocket in the meantime.

Name: Minako
Age: 28
Gender: female
Personality: Minako is very calm and acts calmly in any situation. Even when those around her are emotional, she grasps the facts firmly and responds calmly. As a result, she is often asked for her opinion and often takes on a leadership role. She rarely shows her emotions, but she also has a kind side that she shows to those she trusts. She can be a little stubborn and is strong in her convictions. She is also confident in her physical strength and never neglects her training.
Concern: Every one of these rooms takes longer than anyone admits, and the stretches when it all lands at once are the stretches I get nothing else done. Before we commit for a year I want to know what the hours really look like, and whether handing them off actually removes them.

Name: Sakura
Age: 10
Gender: female
Personality: Sakura is a cheerful girl with a slightly mischievous personality. She is very curious and actively takes on new challenges with enthusiasm. She is good at making people laugh with her pranks and solving little mysteries. She is friendly and gets along well with everyone, so she is good at making friends with those around her. However, she also has a slightly clumsy side, but she has a positive personality that allows her to overcome failures with a smile.
Concern: The bathroom is the room I brace myself before walking into, and the kitchen is fine one day and grim the next with no pattern I can see. I would like to stop having to guess what state a room will be in.

Name: Benjamin
Age: 28
Gender: male
Personality: Benjamin is an intelligent and calm person. He is able to think calmly and rationally, and even in emotional situations, he places importance on logic. In public, he is elegant and polite, often incorporating sarcasm and humor into his conversations, but he is skilled at doing so without hurting others, creating a harmonious atmosphere. He also has an introverted side, often engrossed in deep thought, and occasionally keeps his distance from those around him. However, his calmness and knowledge are factors that earn him the trust of others even in difficult situations.
Concern: It has stopped feeling even — the same rooms seem to land on the same people, and someone who is hardly ever here counts the same as someone who never leaves. I want to see where the using and the work actually sit before we fix anything for a year.

Name: Servas
Age: 85
Gender: male
Personality: Servas has a very calm and composed personality. Based on the knowledge and experience he has gained over the years, he often gives advice to those around him. He is an excellent listener and can talk openly with anyone. He also occasionally expresses deep philosophical thoughts, and his words inspire many people. He is full of vitality and always gives positive energy to those around him.
Concern: Nobody here wants to be the one who brings the kitchen up again, so it goes unsaid until it comes out sideways at someone. Whatever we settle on, I care more about which version leaves us on speaking terms a year from now than about the rooms themselves.

## Hidden information
The options and the full text of every card are listed here. The participants do not know them before the schedule above says so, and nothing from them may appear in the talk before the round in which it is revealed.

Options (see the schedule above):
- A: Fixed Weekly Rota. Each area is assigned to one person for a named week, rotating through the household in a published order that repeats until someone asks for it to be revised.
- B: Paid Cleaning Service. An outside cleaner comes on a set schedule for the shared areas, with the household handling the arrangements and settling the invoice among themselves each month.
- C: Standing Assignments. Each person takes permanent ownership of particular areas for as long as they live there, choosing their own timing rather than following a shared calendar.

Cards (see the schedule above; title: text):
- Bathroom spray stock and the tin's receipts: There are three part-used bottles of the same bathroom spray in the cupboard, and the tin's receipts come to about 2,300 yen a month, much of it bought twice.
- Management office rate sheet and billing: The management office's rate sheet posts a contracted cleaner at 4,200 yen an hour, and the bill goes to one named tenant who then collects from everyone else.
- Stopwatch timing of a full pass: A housemate ran a stopwatch on a proper pass last Sunday: the hob and kitchen floor came to forty-seven minutes, the bathroom thirty-five, the living room twenty.
- Standard terms of the outside firm: The cleaning firm's standard terms give a two-hour arrival window and say anything left on a surface is worked around, so someone must be in and tidy beforehand.
- Bathroom grout after the July scrub: A housemate marked the bathroom grout after scrubbing it in July and the black spotting was back inside eleven days; that small window is the only ventilation the bathroom has.
- What each housemate counts as done: Some of the housemates count a room done once the basin is wiped, others only after the floor and the drain, so its state swings with whoever last had it.
- Absences on the wall calendar: The wall calendar shows two of the five away for a week or more in most months, and one housemate was gone for the whole of August.
- A fortnight's watch on kitchen use: A fortnight of watching the kitchen found that nearly everything that piles up in there comes from two or three housemates cooking, while the rest only make coffee.
- Rows recorded in the house chat: Scrolling back through the house chat, both of the rows the household has had started with one person reminding another about something that had not been done.
- Note left by the previous tenants: The previous tenants left a note inside the cupboard door saying they divided the rooms permanently, and that by the second year two of them barely spoke.
